newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee closes up on late dollar sales.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee closes up on late dollar sales.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed higher in thin Thursday trade after speculators sold the greenback later in the session, dealers said.
The rupee closed at 58.85 to the dollar after opening at 58.95 and falling to 58.97, they said.
"The dollar rose to 58.97 on some late buying in very thin market conditions," said a Commercial Bank dealer.
The forex market which was closed for four days until Wednesday for Sinhala and Tamil new year holidays is still not active, he said.
Overnight call money rates closed at 8.5 percent after opening at 8.75 with the market liquid, dealers said.
